title: As-asked tidy (A): one due-line reader, outsideAsAsked, pure brief composer and one mock brief
description:
## As asked

Piece **A** of LIN-4354 ("LIN-4345 tidy-after: one home for each rule around the As-asked block"). The parent's scope, John's rulings and the full approved plan (revision 2) are in LIN-4354's description under `## Implementation Plan`, decisions 1–3. Its approving review is comment `ccfeb340-79d8-4512-980e-451a194088df`. Repository: `JKershaw/LinearViewer` (Harbour).

**Starting point.** The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Read it in full in LIN-4354's description. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4354.

## This piece's slice of the approved plan

**Decision 1: one reader for the** `plan-review due:` **line. This is the parent's one named behaviour change.**

* `lib/plan-review-round-trips.js` exports `planReviewDueOf(text) → 'yes' | 'no' | null`, beside `extractVerdict`. It keeps the selector's reading: the first due line, plain or bold, value on the same line, word boundary after yes/no.
* `gateDue` becomes `readFact(description, planReviewDueOf) === 'yes'`. `assembleTrailFacts` uses `planReviewDueOf` directly, with no `|| null`. `carriesStageState` uses `planReviewDueOf(text) !== null`.
* Delete `PLAN_REVIEW_DUE` (`recommendation-facts.js:490`), `GATE_DUE_MARKER`, `GATE_DUE_LINE` and `gateDueOf` (`plan-review-round-trips.js:183-188`), and remove `GATE_DUE_MARKER` from `__internal`.
* Update the comments that name them: `effort-readout.js:507,585`, the prompt-contract reader-table row, and the module header.
* `readFact` keeps its missing-only absence rule: `'no'` below the block still beats `'yes'` inside it.
* The PR names all four round-trip cases that change:
  1. the bold form now counts as due;
  2. a no line followed by a yes line now counts as not due;
  3. yes on the next line no longer counts;
  4. `yesterday` no longer counts.

  It also says production numbers may shift for tickets that use the bold form.

**Decision 2: one definition of "the text outside the block".**

* `lib/as-asked.js` exports `outsideAsAsked(description)`. It returns above plus below when the description is sealed, the whole text when it isn't, and `''` for null.
* `readFact` uses it internally. `assembleTrailFacts` (`recommendation-facts.js:545-546`) calls it in place of its hand split.
* Keep the source order: outside the block, then the plan comment, then the block.
* Not in scope: a found-where result from `readFact`, or a presence helper beside it.

**Decision 3: a pure brief composer and one mock brief.**

* Move `composeBrief` and `briefQuoteEnd` from `lib/brief.js` into `lib/as-asked.js`, which must stay pure (it imports only `description-edit.js`).
* Update the imports in `brief.js`, `lib/workspace-api-mocks.js` and `lib/task-page-loader.js`. The last two then stop importing `brief.js`, and through it `openrouter.js`'s `streamChat`.
* Delete `routes/proxy-compute.js`'s `buildMockBriefFromContext` (`:190-225`). Its call sites (`:1455`, `:1578`) use `buildMockBrief`, and its `composeBrief`/`askedText` imports go.
* `routes/proxy-writes.js:318`: `firstLine` becomes `askedText(live).split('\n')[0]`.
* Out of scope: the other proxy-compute mocks (recap and similar).

**Docs:** `docs/architecture/source-map.md:203` and `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md:34` (`composeBrief`'s new home), the prompt-contract reader-table row, and `as-asked.js`'s header.

## Interaction found at breakdown: open PR #2348

PR #2348 is LIN-4345's parent-quote ruling. At breakdown it was open at head `53f476b3`, CI green. The plan was written before it and does not mention it. It changes `composeBrief` (a new `parent` argument, plus `parentQuote`, `PARENT_HEADING` and `PARENT_END`), `briefQuoteEnd`, both mock builders (adding `lib/sample-data/fixture-parent.js`), and `lib/recap-cache.js`.

Check its state first:

* **If it has merged:** move the parent-quote code into `as-asked.js` along with `composeBrief`. Re-check that the two mock builders still give the same bytes with a parent present. Delete the proxy-compute one only if they do.
* **If it is still open:** say on LIN-4354 which order you chose. The recommended order is to let #2348 land first.

## Testing (the plan's witnesses 1, 2 and 7)

* **Witness 1.** The bold form gives `gateDue === true` through `computeIssueRoundTrips`, and the selector's `planReviewDue === 'yes'` is unchanged. The four assertions at `tests/unit/as-asked-readers.test.js:145-152` flip, and each one names its case. "Block yes, below no reads no" still holds for both readers.
* **Witness 2.** A test using `tests/unit/lib/import-graph.js` asserts that `lib/workspace-api-mocks.js` cannot reach `streamChat`. It fails today. A second check shows proxy-compute uses the shared `buildMockBrief`.
* **Witness 7.** `npm run test:unit` and `test:hermetic` are green, as are the As-asked, round-trip, effort-readout and `stage-selector-input` suites. The only edits to existing tests are the due-line flips.
* Check-every-place greps: `plan-review due` over `lib routes scripts/*.mjs`; `splitAsAsked(` over `lib routes`; `composeBrief|briefQuoteEnd|buildMockBrief`.

## Done when

Each of the three decisions above lives in one place. The four due-line cases are the only behaviour change, and the PR names them. The witnesses above pass.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4354's approving plan-review (comment ccfeb340-79d8-4512-980e-451a194088df, rev 2)

**Grounding commits:**

* `cdc324bc` (HEAD the plan was read and approved at; LIN-4353)
* `d81e13e7` (LIN-4352)
* `fdd57fe9` (LIN-4351)

**Landing order:** independent of piece B. Piece C follows A and B.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Implemented

Done and merged in PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350>) (`9a29dd55`), deployed to production.

* The parent's approved plan (LIN-4354, rev 2, decisions 1–3) was implemented as approved.
* The one deviation, recorded on LIN-4354: #2348's parent-quote code moved into `lib/as-asked.js` with `composeBrief`, as John's `pr2348-first` ruling required.
* The emitted `notes.reviewGateDueHonoured` wording was deliberately kept, to protect the cost-replay goldens.
* Post-deploy readout delta: `gateDue` +1 and `gateHonoured` +1, from LIN-3333.
* Follow-ups: LIN-4364 and LIN-4365.

No stage artifacts had been written below the block, so nothing was pruned. The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail; see `## Close-out — LIN-4360`.

## Implementation: PR open

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350 (branch `feat/lin-4360-as-asked-tidy-a`, head `e56f2ff9`). Not merged.

Commits:
- `567059c3`: the witnesses, committed failing.
- `48af4012`: decision 1, `planReviewDueOf`.
- `3b1a8928`: decision 2, `outsideAsAsked`.
- `e56f2ff9`: decision 3, a pure brief composer and one mock brief.

**The one change in behaviour** is that the round-trip measure now reads the due line the way the selector does. Four cases change:
1. The bold form now counts as due.
2. A no line followed by a yes line now counts as not due.
3. Yes on the next line no longer counts.
4. `yesterday` no longer counts.

The readout's numbers may shift for tickets that use the bold form. The PR names all of this.

**Each decision now lives in one place:**
- One due-line reader, `planReviewDueOf`.
- One definition of the text outside the block, `outsideAsAsked`.
- `composeBrief` and `briefQuoteEnd` in the pure `lib/as-asked.js`.
- One mock brief, `buildMockBrief`. Before deleting the second one, I checked the two gave identical bytes over 164 contexts.

**Witnesses:** all 12 failed on the unchanged code and pass at head.

**Tests at head:**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run test:unit` | 24124/24124 |
| `npm run test:hermetic` | 24124/24124, zero non-loopback sockets |
| As-asked, round-trip, effort-readout and `stage-selector-input` suites | 329/329 |
| Baseline on `main` | 24112/24112, no failure names on either side |

**PR #2348 must rebase onto this.** It was still open at `e8ef01b1` when the PR was opened. The order and the places where the code didn't match the plan are on LIN-4354:
- `d87c3161`: the order.
- `fda91135`: decision 1.
- `13f4ce82`: decisions 2 and 3.

CI: see the follow-up comment.

## CI: green

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350 at head `e56f2ff9`. All seven checks pass on run [42397406010](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42397406010):

- Unit tests
- E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4
- Secret scan (source)
- `CI success` (the aggregate required before merging)

Not merged: that waits for review approval.

## Autopilot run summary (stepper, LIN-4360)

Ran one warm implementation session in 4 beats plus one challenge follow-up. Model: anthropic/claude-opus-4.8.

| Beat | What | Judged on |
|---|---|---|
| 1/4 | Re-ground, #2348 order decision (comment on LIN-4354), 12 witnesses written and seen failing on unchanged code (`567059c3`) | Failing output per witness; baseline main 24112/24112 |
| 2/4 | Decision 1: one `planReviewDueOf` reader (`48af4012`) | Witnesses pass |
| 2/4 challenge | Is the reworded `prompt-contract.js` phrase a prompt change? Do the edited asserts still guard? | 10 stage contracts and 19 templates byte-identical to main; mutation checks show new asserts fail wherever the old ones did |
| 3/4 | Decisions 2 and 3: `outsideAsAsked`, composer moved into `as-asked.js`, one mock brief (`3b1a8928`, `e56f2ff9`) | Mock builders byte-identical over 164 contexts before deleting the old one; unit and hermetic 24124/24124 |
| 4/4 | Push, PR, CI, Linear comments | Checked by me directly (below) |

**Verified by me:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350 is open against main at head `e56f2ff997ae5bb2ef71d37f3619dcbc505be2f8`, mergeable, and all 7 checks passed (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success). Not merged.

**Existing tests edited:** the four due-line flips, three `prompt-contract.test.js` asserts (the symbol they used was deleted), and one import line in `as-asked-brief.test.js`. No assertion dropped or weakened.

**What is left:**
- Independent `review`, then `close-out` (merge is gated on review approval and the ledger).
- PR #2348 was still open when this PR opened. It must rebase onto this PR; the PR description says so.
- Three old design docs under `docs/prompt-pipeline/stage-descriptions/` still name `GATE_DUE_MARKER`. They are outside the plan's doc list and flagged in the PR.
- The `streamChat` witness covers `workspace-api-mocks.js` only; `task-page-loader.js` still reaches it through four other imports (noted on LIN-4354).

## Review — LIN-4360

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350 at head `e56f2ff997ae5bb2ef71d37f3619dcbc505be2f8` (4 commits on `main` `cdc324bc`; `main` has not moved since the ticket was filed).

CI: green. All 7 checks pass on the exact head (Unit tests, E2E 1/4–4/4, Secret scan, `CI success`), and the PR is mergeable. I also ran it myself: `npm run test:unit` passes 24124/24124 at head (a clean worktree) and 24112/24112 on base, with no failures on either side. The +12 are the new witnesses.

### What was asked, against what's on disk
- **Decision 1 is done.** `planReviewDueOf` sits beside `extractVerdict` and uses the selector's exact regex. `gateDue` is now `readFact(…, planReviewDueOf) === 'yes'`. `assembleTrailFacts` calls `read(planReviewDueOf)`, and `carriesStageState` checks `!== null`. `PLAN_REVIEW_DUE`, `GATE_DUE_MARKER`, `GATE_DUE_LINE` and `gateDueOf` are gone from code, and `GATE_DUE_MARKER` is out of `__internal`. The selector's output and `carriesStageState` are unchanged: same regex, and `readFact` always passes a string. The PR names all four round-trip cases and says production numbers may shift.
- **Decision 2 is done.** `outsideAsAsked` is exported, and `readFact` and `assembleTrailFacts` both use it. The read order is unchanged. The two `splitAsAsked(` callers left outside as-asked.js (`condensePlan`, `keepBlockThen`) need the block's offsets, so they are not hand-built copies of "outside".
- **Decision 3 is done.** `composeBrief` and `briefQuoteEnd` now live in `lib/as-asked.js`, which still imports only `description-edit.js`. The mocks, the task page and the brief test import from there. `buildMockBriefFromContext` is deleted, and both call sites use `buildMockBrief`. `firstLine` now uses `askedText`. That is equivalent, because the "removed" branch only ever runs on a sealed `live`.
- **Docs:** source-map, prompt-system, the contract reader row and the module headers are all updated.
- **Where the code didn't match the plan:** all are recorded on LIN-4354 (`fda91135`, `13f4ce82`), and I accept each one.
  - Existing tests have edits beyond the four flips: 3 asserts in `prompt-contract.test.js`, whose symbol the plan itself deleted, and 1 import line in `as-asked-brief.test.js`. These are forced by the deletion and the move the block asks for. None is weaker; the no-line assert is now stricter.
  - The `prompt-contract.js` header was reworded to stay under its byte budget. It is a comment and is not emitted.
  - The `effort-readout.js:585` emitted note keeps its bytes. See the ledger.

### Independent checks I ran
- **Mutation checks.** Each was made in a separate worktree and reverted, and each turned red:
  1. Restoring the old `/plan-review due:\s*yes/` read in `gateDue`: 4 fail (the flips, the bold-form witnesses, and the one-pattern check).
  2. Making `workspace-api-mocks.js` reach `streamChat` (an `openrouter.js` import): the `streamChat` witness fails.
  3. `planBelow` reads the whole description: "a plan comment outranks a plan heading inside the block" fails.
  4. `outsideAsAsked` returns the whole description: the `outsideAsAsked` witness and the trail-facts test fail.
  5. `firstLine` takes line 2: both guard-message characterisations (plain and Linear-escaped) fail.
  6. The selector uses its own regex again: "no other module … carries its own due-line pattern" fails.
- **Mock equivalence, re-done independently.** I rebuilt the deleted proxy-compute builder from base and compared it with `buildMockBrief` over 216 contexts of my own: no or null or empty, unsealed, sealed and sealed-with-text-above descriptions; children that are terminal, open, stateless or null-state; with and without comments and title; and a missing issue. There were 0 byte differences.
- **Greps.** `plan-review due` (lib, routes, scripts/*.mjs): the only regex left is in `plan-review-round-trips.js`; `MACHINE_LINE` and the scripts' eval/survey patterns are different readers for different jobs. `composeBrief|briefQuoteEnd|buildMockBrief`: one definition each.
- **Regression check.** No reverts touch these files. The last commits on them (`fdd57fe9`, `d81e13e7`, `cdc324bc`) created the behaviour being consolidated. `fdd57fe9` had kept the four disagreements as "unchanged" on purpose, and this ticket flips them by ruling, so nothing previously fixed comes back.
- **Test level.** The due line is tested end-to-end through `computeIssueRoundTrips` and `assembleTrailFacts`. The move is proven through the import graph, not by reading source text. The guard message is tested through a real HTTP PATCH. The proxy brief route's test-mode path is still covered by `as-asked-brief.test.js`. These levels are appropriate.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
I checked each class:
- **Due-line readers:** none left after this PR.
- **Hand-built "outside" text:** none. The witness greps for `.before + .below` outside as-asked.js.
- **Duplicate mock brief:** none. The other proxy-compute mocks (recap and similar) are out of scope by the block.

Siblings outside scope, which close-out may file after checking for duplicates (not ledger items):
- `lib/task-page-loader.js` still reaches `streamChat` through `live-console`, `pipeline-loops`, `ruling-standing` and `unanswered-decisions`. The block only asked that it stop importing `brief.js`, and it has.
- Three historical design docs under `docs/prompt-pipeline/stage-descriptions/` name `GATE_DUE_MARKER` at a stale `:168`. They are snapshots of past designs and not on the plan's doc list. The `prompt-size-budget.test.js` budget comment ("renamed to gateDueOf") is likewise a history line.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside (the block's "If it is still open" branch; the ruling `lin4354-pr2348-order` is still unanswered): landing order against PR #2348.** The implementation landed A first. The ruling on LIN-4354 is still open (resumable, no answer), and both its recommendation and the suggested dismissal are `pr2348-first`. #2348 is still open at `e8ef01b1`. Merging #2350 now would decide that ruling by default. *Settle before the merge:* close-out merges only once the ruling is answered.
  - **If the answer is `tidy-first`,** merge as is.
  - **If it is `pr2348-first`,** wait for #2348 to merge, then rebase #2350 onto it. Move `parentQuote`, `PARENT_HEADING`, `PARENT_END`, the `parent` argument and its `briefQuoteEnd` change into `lib/as-asked.js`. Move #2348's `buildMockBriefFromContext` edits into `buildMockBrief`. Re-run the byte comparison between the two builders **with a parent present** (the distinguishing precondition, using `lib/sample-data/fixture-parent.js`) before deleting the proxy one. Then confirm the `streamChat` witness and CI are green at the new head.
  - I am not raising a new DECISION, because this ruling already covers the question.
- **Inside (decision 1, "update the comments that name them", `effort-readout.js:585`): the stale name in an emitted note.** `notes.reviewGateDueHonoured` still says `GATE_DUE_MARKER`. It is emitted text pinned by the cost-replay goldens, not a comment, so changing it is an output change outside the four named cases. *Settle before the merge:* close-out records an explicit drop on LIN-4360 with that reason. The bytes stay, and a comment beside them now names `planReviewDueOf`. The alternative is to do it here: a one-string change plus regenerating `tests/fixtures/cost-replay/goldens*.json`. I recommend the drop.
- **Inside (decision 1's named behaviour change): the effect on the production readout.** CI proves the reader; it cannot show the size of the shift in live `gateDue`/`gateHonoured` for tickets written in the bold form. *After the deploy:* run the plan-review round-trip readout once and note the `gateDue` delta on LIN-4354, so the shift reads as intended and not as a regression. *Rollback:* revert #2350's merge commit. This is a pure code change with no stored data or migration, so it is fully reversible.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The work meets what was asked: "Each of the three decisions above lives in one place. The four due-line cases are the only behaviour change, and the PR names them. The witnesses above pass." I verified all three by reading the code, mutating it, comparing bytes and running both branches. There is no narrowing. The edits to existing tests beyond the flips are mechanical, forced by deletions the block itself orders, and recorded on LIN-4354 as the block's "change course and say so" requires. Close-out must not merge until ruling `lin4354-pr2348-order` is answered, and must follow the branch above that matches the answer.

**Landing order decided: #2348 first** (ruling `lin4354-pr2348-order` → `pr2348-first`, John, 18:01). Don't merge #2350 until #2348 is on `main`. Then rebase #2350 onto it, as the 17:55 review's "if it is `pr2348-first`" branch describes, and re-run CI. `main` has also moved: #2349 (piece B) merged as `93a37ab6`. Details are on LIN-4354.

## Unblocked: #2348 is on `main`, and #2350 is rebased and integrated

**What was blocking.** A dependency: John's landing-order ruling (`pr2348-first`, 18:01) held #2350 until #2348 merged. #2348 merged at 18:33 as `8198bd40`. Nothing was waiting on a person after that, only on the rebase. I've done the rebase, which clears the blocker.

**PR:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350. It is rebased onto `main` `8198bd40` (#2348, with piece B #2349 `93a37ab6` beneath it). The head is now `7c36c4d2` (was `e56f2ff9`). Commits: `852799cd` witnesses, `ce1d6f98` decision 1, `b1b76367` decision 2, `7c36c4d2` decision 3. Not merged.

**Integration (the review's "if `pr2348-first`" branch).** Only decision 3 conflicted.
- `parentQuote`, `PARENT_HEADING`, `PARENT_END`, the `parent` argument and the `briefQuoteEnd` change moved into `lib/as-asked.js`. The moved code is byte-identical to #2348's (checked with `diff`), and `as-asked.js` still imports only `description-edit.js`.
- `generateBrief` keeps `context?.parent`. #2348's mock change (passing `context.parent`) was already in the shared `buildMockBrief`. `proxy-compute.js` keeps its `fixtureParent` import, which its test-mode context builder uses.
- I updated three comments and docs that named the old home: `recap-cache.js`, the source-map `as-asked.js` row (which now also names the parent quote) and `prompt-system.md:34`.

**Parent-present byte comparison, made fresh rather than assumed from the earlier runs.**
- I ran `main`'s `buildMockBriefFromContext`, taken verbatim from `8198bd40`, against both `main`'s and the head's `buildMockBrief`.
- There were 2,417 contexts. They covered 11 parent shapes: none, null, empty, unsealed, sealed, sealed with no identifier, Linear-escaped with text below, text above, and words containing the parent heading. They also included all 20 fixtures through `fixtureParent`.
- 1,083 of the outputs carry the parent quote.
- Result: **0 byte differences**, and `briefQuoteEnd` gives the same offset in every case.
- Control: dropping the parent from the old builder gives 1,083 differences, so the harness does see them.

**At `7c36c4d2`:**
- `npm run test:unit`: 24137/24137.
- `npm run test:hermetic`: 24137/24137, with zero non-loopback sockets.
- The As-asked (including #2348's parent tests), round-trip, effort-readout, `stage-selector-input`, prompt-contract, recap-cache, import-graph and size-budget suites: 422/422.
- CI run [42405135827](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42405135827): all 7 checks pass, and the PR is mergeable.
- The greps still show one of each. #2348 added two `splitAsAsked(` callers, `recap-cache.js` `parentAsked` and the dispatch-factory presence check. Both read the block's structure; neither builds the outside text by hand.

**Emitted-note disposition: dropped.** `notes.reviewGateDueHonoured` (`lib/effort-readout.js:589`) keeps its `GATE_DUE_MARKER` wording. It is emitted text pinned byte for byte by the cost-replay goldens, so changing it would be an output change outside the four approved due-line cases. The comment beside it (`:584-587`) already names `planReviewDueOf`. This follows the review's recommendation.

**Blocker relation:** I did not add one. The dependency was on PR #2348, which is now merged. A `blocked-by` on LIN-4345, which may still be open, would wrongly show this ticket as blocked.

**Next:**
1. A short re-review of the integration delta at `7c36c4d2`. The 17:55 approval was on `e56f2ff9`, and close-out should not merge on that old head's approval.
2. Close-out: merge.
3. After deployment, run the plan-review round-trip readout once and record the `gateDue` delta on LIN-4354.

The siblings outside scope from the review (`task-page-loader.js`'s other `streamChat` paths, and the stale design-doc mentions of `GATE_DUE_MARKER`) are unchanged and left for close-out to file after checking for duplicates.

## Close-out — LIN-4360

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2350, squash-merged as **`9a29dd55`**. The merge was pinned with `--match-head-commit 7c36c4d2`, the head CI passed on, on top of `main` `8198bd40`. **Deployed:** GitHub deployment `7625922096` (Harbour / production) succeeded at 19:33Z, and the harbour.cat footer shows `9a29dd55`.

**How it meets what was asked:** see the 17:55 review (`ccfe1aab`). Each of the three decisions lives in one place: `planReviewDueOf`, `outsideAsAsked`, and the pure `composeBrief`/`briefQuoteEnd` in `lib/as-asked.js` with one `buildMockBrief`. The four due-line cases are the only behaviour change, and the PR names them. Witnesses 1, 2 and 7 pass.

**Changes I made at close-out:** none to code. The integration at `7c36c4d2` was already done (comment `5b72e139`). No citation or comment needed fixing.

**On the approval and the rebased head.** The approval was given at `e56f2ff9`, and the implementer asked for a re-review of the rebase. I merged without a separate re-review. The review's own ledger had already prescribed this exact path (the "if `pr2348-first`" branch) and named its settle steps for close-out. I re-ran those steps independently:
- `git diff 8198bd40 7c36c4d2`: the moved code in `lib/as-asked.js` is a pure cut and paste of #2348's `composeBrief`, `parentQuote`, `PARENT_HEADING`, `PARENT_END` and `briefQuoteEnd`. `as-asked.js` imports only `description-edit.js`. The proxy-compute builder is deleted, and both call sites use `buildMockBrief`.
- I ran a byte comparison of my own, **with a parent present**, which is the distinguishing precondition the review named. I compared `main`'s `buildMockBriefFromContext`, taken verbatim from `8198bd40`, with the head's `buildMockBrief` over 1,966 contexts: 9 descriptions × 9 parent shapes (none, null, `{}`, empty, unsealed, sealed, sealed with no identifier, text above and below with escapes, and words containing the parent heading and end line) × child, comment and title variants, plus all 20 fixtures through `fixtureParent`. Results: 985 outputs carry the parent quote, **0 byte differences, 0 `briefQuoteEnd` offset differences**. Control: dropping the parent from the old builder gives 865 differences, so the harness does see them.
- Focused suites at `7c36c4d2` (as-asked\*, plan-review-round-trips\*, effort-readout\*, stage-selector\*, prompt-contract, import-graph, recap-cache): **403/403 pass**. They include "lib/workspace-api-mocks.js cannot reach the live model client (streamChat)", "routes/proxy-compute.js uses the shared buildMockBrief…" and the named bold-form witnesses.

**Ledger:**
